transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I came in because I don’t feel like myself. It’s like the warm part of me just shut off. I’ll be sitting with my husband, or trying to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort or maybe a little happy, but… there’s just nothing there.
Have you noticed a loss of pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with loved ones?
Yeah… I guess so. Like, I sit with my husband, or I try to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel… something. Comfort, maybe. But it’s just kind of blank. Nothing really reaches me.
Do you find yourself feeling down or sad most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t call it sad exactly. It’s more like I’m just kind of… flat. Most days, yeah, but I don’t really know how to describe it.
Do you feel down or experience a depressed mood most of the day, nearly every day?
I… I’m not sure I’d call it depressed. It’s more like I don’t feel much of anything. Most days are just kind of flat.
Would you say you feel down or experience a depressed mood most days, or is it more that you just don’t feel much at all?
It’s more that I don’t feel much. Like… the warm part of me just shut off. I can sit with my husband or put on my shows, and I know I should feel comfort or something, but there’s just… nothing.
Would you say you have a depressed mood, or is it more that you can't feel pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
More that I can’t really feel… good things. Like I’ll sit with my husband or put on shows I used to like after work, and I know I should feel comfort or maybe a little happy, but it’s just… nothing.
So, just to make sure I understand, are you saying that you don’t feel pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or do you also feel down or hopeless most days?

It’s more the not feeling pleasure, I think. I’m not really… hopeless all day. It’s just like that warm feeling shut off. I’ll be with my husband or watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort or something, but there’s just nothing.
Would you say you feel down or experience a depressed mood, even if it’s not all day?
I don’t know… maybe a little here and there. I wouldn’t say it’s like I’m sad all day. It’s more just… flat, I guess.
Would you say you feel down or experience a depressed mood at times, even if it’s not all day?
I guess maybe a little, sometimes. But I don’t really know if I’d call it depressed. It’s more just… not much there.
Would you say that most days, for most of the day, you feel down or in a depressed mood, even if it's not severe?
No… I don’t think it’s most of the day. I get kind of low sometimes, but mostly it’s just… blank, not really depressed.
Would you say that on most days, even if not all day, you experience a depressed mood or feel down for a significant part of the day?
I don’t think so. I mean… I have moments where I feel kind of low, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big part of most days. Mostly I just feel kind of… quiet or empty, I guess.
Would you say that on most days, you feel down or in a depressed mood for at least half of the day?
No… I don’t think it’s that much. I have parts of the day where I feel low, but not half the day, I don’t think.
Would you say that on most days, even if not all day, you feel down or in a depressed mood for a significant part of the day?
I don’t know… I’ve kind of already tried to answer that. I get low sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d call it a significant part of most days.
Would you say that on most days, even if not all day, you feel down or in a depressed mood for at least some part of the day?
I mean… maybe some days, yeah, for a little while. But I don’t really keep track of it, so I’m not sure.
Would you say that on most days, even if only for a short time, you feel down or in a depressed mood?
I’m not really sure. Maybe here and there, but I haven’t been paying attention to it like that.
Would you say that on most days, even if only for a short time, you feel down or in a depressed mood?
I don’t really know. I guess maybe sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed it being most days.
Have you noticed a loss of interest in activities you used to care about, like work, hobbies, or being around other people?

Yeah… kind of. I still do the things, like sit with my husband or put on my shows after work, but it’s like I don’t feel anything from it. Like the warm part of me just shut off. I know I should feel comforted or happy, but… it’s just not there.
Would you say that you’ve completely stopped getting any pleasure or satisfaction from activities you used to enjoy, like sitting with your husband or watching your favorite shows?

Yeah… I mean, pretty much. I still sit with my husband, I still put my shows on after work, but it doesn’t really… land. I know I should feel comforted or a little happy, but it’s just kind of nothing. Like that warm feeling is shut off.
Would you say that on most days, even if only for a short time, you feel down or in a depressed mood?
I don’t know… not really most days, I don’t think. It’s hard for me to tell.
Would you say that on most days, even if only for a short time, you feel down or in a depressed mood?
I… I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say it’s most days exactly. I just feel kind of off, I guess, but I’m not sure I’d call it depressed.
